outcome_text.validation_failed: rule 1: the crystal-start runs left the crystal pose in two or three runs; the simulation is a failed validation and supports nothing
outcome_text.rotated_converts: rule 3: the rotated starts converted in two or three runs and the crystal and near-native starts stayed; the rotated orientation is not stable outside the scoring function
outcome_text.both_persist: rule 3: no run left its starting orientation; both orientations persisted and the simulation does not decide
outcome_text.mixed: rule 3: the runs disagree; they are reported run by run and nothing is averaged over them
